alternatives_considered.approach: Add a root app/loading.tsx skeleton boundary for the whole route.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The boundary would also paint over the static visitor landing on first navigation; a Suspense boundary scoped to the signed-in async child gives skeletons exactly where data loads and nowhere else.

alternatives_considered.approach: Derive member count from balances.length, avoiding any extra read.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: computeNetBalances appends departed ledger participants behind current members, so its length overcounts real membership; listMembers is the group page's own source of truth for who is in the group.

alternatives_considered.approach: Add a batched member-count column to listGroupsForUser.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The issue forbids any new data shape on the server path, and changing a shared query risks its other callers; reusing the existing listMembers read keeps the contract unchanged.

alternatives_considered.approach: Drop the All activity link, the left-group notice, and the exclusion note under a strict reading of follows ui.md Home structure exactly.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The activity link is the only UI path to /activity (account menu links only /profile, the group excerpt does not link out), so dropping it strands TR-10's feed; dropping the exclusion note makes totals silently incomplete; dropping the notice removes the qa/selectors.md assertion surface. All three are additive and stay.

work_order.approach: Migrate only the signed-in half of app/page.tsx to the ui.md Home screen, reusing the existing queries with no new endpoint or data shape (calls only regrouped into withDb blocks, the established activity/group-page pattern). Read the session eagerly in HomePage but inside its own try/catch with unstable_rethrow(error) first in the catch: session/boot failure renders <MarketingFrame><BootFailure /></MarketingFrame> exactly as today, while group-read failure with a live session renders HomeFailure inside the shell. Move listGroupsForUser plus the sequential per-group loop (computeNetBalances, simplifyDebts, plus listMembers for the member count) plus summarizeHome into an async SignedInGroups child inside <Suspense fallback={<HomeSkeleton/>}>, with the failure card and unstable_rethrow living in the child. Decide the section through the pure exported homeSections({groupCount, failedCount}) (groupCount 0 -> empty; failedCount === groupCount with groupCount > 0 -> failure; 0 < failedCount < groupCount -> partial; failedCount 0 -> loaded): all-failed renders HomeFailure, some-failed renders loaded groups with inline retry rows plus the incomplete-totals note, zero groups renders HomeEmpty only (no summary card, no People section, header/fixed Create copies suppressed). Render the ?left= role=status notice and the All activity link in HomePage above the boundary; keep the exclusion note inside with the summary. Build components/home-panels.tsx as pure presentational (no hooks, no server-only imports): BalanceSummaryCard (hero net owed-minus-owe in viewer currency as the largest text with its direction sentence in the matching tone, owed/owe totals beside it, exclusion note naming every foreign-currency group including zero-balance ones, incomplete note when partial, settled-up sentence only when owedMinor and oweMinor are both 0; no Card title so the page keeps its h1), PeopleList (Avatar tinted by person.key with name fallback, string titles so the ListRow tooltip holds, words-plus-colour direction, zero-net rows neutral with no amount, People empty sentence when empty; departed/placeholder counterparts render as ordinary rows with no departed badge in this slice), GroupList (whole-row links with avatar mark, name, pluralized member count, per-group balance in group currency with words plus the sr-only Balance label, ChevronRight, inline 44px retry rows), HomeEmpty (EmptyState owning the Create action when empty), HomeFailure (message plus retry link to /, no numbers), HomeSkeleton (shared Skeleton inside data-skeleton wrapper divs with one block per region — summary, people, group rows — aria-busy container, sr-only loading text with no live role). Keep one h1 at text-page above the cards with section h2s, 44px targets, data-amount on every amount, lucide icons aria-hidden. Render Create as the group-list section-header button on desktop plus a fixed bottom button on phones (hidden/sm:hidden exclusive, compensating bottom padding, both 44px). Landing half, guard flow, and the queries themselves stay exactly as they are; the landing is proven by the new signed-out QA step, and retry is proven by restart-plus-click.

work_order.confidence_rationale: The data path is verified in-tree and reused untouched, the shared set exists, and every critique claim was re-checked against the code before folding its fix in — the hero-words gap, the empty-branch ambiguity, the unproven retry, the unguarded landing, the people-less skeleton, the understated read count, the unobservable survive-loading clause, the double live region, the copied skeleton classes, and the unproven shared components. What would move the number up is seeing the skeleton marker in a served stream, a Neon-latency read on the 1+5N to 1+6N loop, and a green restart-plus-Retry probe; what would move it down is the shared set misfitting Home (Card title level, ListRow truncation, Avatar tint fallback) with AC-7 forbidding any ui.tsx change, or the retry link replaying a cached RSC payload instead of refetching.
work_order.debate_summary: All ten critique findings were sustained after re-checking the evidence in-tree, and none contradicted a decision in plan/brief.md (which pins only docs/ui.md and prior decisions as-is). Major: (1) hero direction words added to files[] and AC-1/AC-3 with two unit cases, since the plan named words only for the settled case while formatMinorUnits renders a bare signed figure; (2) empty branch fixed to HomeEmpty-only with absent-block assertions, since IAC-1's unqualified summary-card clause and summarizeHome([]) zeros allowed a zero hero plus two empty sentences on a new account; (3) retry given its proving step (restart DB, click Retry, loaded Home) in AC-4 and qa_script, since both retries link to the URL already on screen and residual_risks admitted the refetch was unproven; (4) landing given a signed-out qa_script step plus AC-10 and the false 'existing landing assertions' line removed from risks, since no test renders app/page.tsx and all seven QA steps assumed sign-in; (5) skeleton fixed to one data-skeleton block per loaded region (summary, people, group rows) in files[]/AC-8 with a per-region unit case, since the People section sits between the two named regions and its absence is a layout shift. Minor: (6) read count restated honestly as 1+5N to 1+6N (~20% on the per-group loop, not a doubling) in risks/residuals; (7) 'survive loading' removed from the AC-2 check text with survival-through-failure homed in AC-9 unit cases, since PGlite never yields a paint window; (8) skeleton loading text given no live role (aria-busy only) with a ?left=-while-loading combination case, since the notice above the boundary plus a status fallback mount two live regions at once; (9) skeleton built from the shared Skeleton inside data-skeleton wrappers per the contract face, instead of a copied class string; (10) render cases for Card/ListRow/Badge/EmptyState added to app/home.test.ts without touching ui.tsx. Of the missed edges, one-group-no-expenses, group-of-one, many-people, foreign-zero-balance agreement, and string-title truncation were folded as unit/QA cases; departed-seat badging and identical-name disambiguation were deliberately not made criteria — both need a design decision beyond the IACs, so the plan pins current behaviour (ordinary rows, no badge, no group context) and carries them as residual risks rather than widening the ticket.

residual_risks: The skeleton marker may never appear in a locally served stream because PGlite resolves inside the microtask queue; the qa_script and AC-8 state the explicit pass in that case (unit case plus fallback markup), so a correct implementation cannot fail QA locally.

The loop is 1+5N sequential reads today and 1+6N with the added listMembers read per group (about 20% on the per-group loop, not a doubling); invisible locally for the same PGlite reason, payable on Neon against the TR-11 1s budget — group counts are small in practice but unproven at the tail, and this ticket adds no timing step.

Retry links point at / via soft navigation to the URL already on screen; if the App Router replays the cached RSC payload instead of refetching, retry looks like it does nothing — the restart-plus-click failure probe must confirm the refetch, and any refresh-semantics fix belongs to a follow-up.

Home is the shared set's first screen consumer, so any misfit (Card title level, ListRow truncation, Avatar tint fallback) has no proven fallback inside this ticket; AC-7 forbids touching components/ui.tsx, and the new render cases only pin the assumed markup.
Two placeholder seats sharing one display name in different groups share an Avatar tint via the name fallback; cosmetic only, accepted.

Two people with identical display names in different groups render as indistinguishable rows (avatar, name, amount only, no group context); needs a design decision, so this slice documents it rather than solving it.

Departed ledger participants (ADR-0007) render on Home as ordinary person rows with no 'No longer in the group' mark, unlike the group page; leaving with a balance is blocked so a nonzero ghost row should be rare, but the difference is deliberate scope control, not an oversight.
The fixed mobile Create button's overlap compensation and iOS safe-area inset have no in-repo precedent; the 375px screenshot with a long list is the proof.

An account whose every group is archived sees the first-group empty copy, because listGroupsForUser excludes archived groups; distinguishing all-archived from never-had-groups would widen this ticket.

A group whose balance read succeeded but whose listMembers count read failed renders as a fully failed group row and is dropped from the summary inputs, pushing the hero into the incomplete note; one try per group keeps this honest but coarse.
The People list is uncapped: an account with dozens of counterparts renders dozens of rows; a cap or collapse rule would be new behaviour and is not in this ticket.
risks: One extra listMembers read per group runs sequentially (PGlite single connection): the loop moves from 1+5N to 1+6N reads per Home visit, about 20% on the per-group loop against the TR-11 1s budget; group counts on Home are small in practice and the reads stay in the existing loop rather than a new fan-out — but the cost is invisible locally and only shows on Neon, which QA never runs.

The HomePage restructure touches the file the visitor landing lives in, so the landing-half-unchanged promise rests on diff review plus the new signed-out QA step and AC-10, not on structural separation; the eager-read guard is what keeps BootFailure reachable for logged-out visitors.

issue_snapshot.title: Home dashboard with balances, people and groups
issue_snapshot.body:
A signed-in user sees in one glance whether they owe or are owed, who with, and which group needs attention, with groups as rich rows.

UI face: signed-in user opens Home and sees net position, per-person owes/owed rows with avatars, and rich group rows with the create action always reachable. Contract face: consumes the shell, tokens, and shared rows/cards/avatars/badges/skeletons from piece 1 unchanged; reads the existing home balance and group queries through the current server path with no new endpoint or data shape. Follows docs/ui.md Home screen structure and states exactly.

**Out of scope**
- Any balance-math, simplification, or query change; numbers come from the existing recompute path
- Group page, expense editor, settle-up, members, activity, and profile screens
- Dark mode

Covers: TR-11, S-8
Part of #31.
Depends on #33.

## Acceptance (from the split)
- **IAC-1** Home shows the app shell plus a balance summary card whose hero number is the net position, with you-are-owed and you-owe totals beside it.
- **IAC-2** Per-person rows show who the user owes and who owes the user, each with an avatar, name, and words-plus-colour direction; group list shows rich rows with name, member count, per-group balance, and chevron.
- **IAC-3** Zero balances read neutral (All settled up style), never debt red; every amount renders in group currency from one formatter with words plus colour, never colour alone.
- **IAC-4** Empty state shows an illustration or icon, one sentence on what Tabs does, and a Create-your-first-group button; loading shows skeleton summary card and group rows with no layout shift; failure shows retry and never presents cached balances as current.
- **IAC-5** Primary Create group action is obvious: header button on desktop and thumb-reachable fixed button on phones; cards stack vertically at 375px and lay out up to 1024px.
- **IAC-6** Row hit targets are 44px, keyboard path and visible focus hold, one h1 with heading hierarchy, icons are lucide-react aria-hidden next to text, and the ui.md checklists pass.
